identificationModule.briefTitle: Dose-Ranging Study of Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Virus 16/18 Bivalent Vaccine
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled, Dose-Ranging Study of Recombinant Human Papillomavirus Virus 16/18 Bivalent Vaccine (E.Coli)in Healthy Female Subjects Aged 18 to 25 Years

collaborators.name: Beijing Wantai Biological Pharmacy Enterprise Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary:
This is a phase II clinical study of the novel recombinant HPV 16/18 bivalent vaccine expressed in E. coli.

The primary purpose of this study is to evaluate which dosage of the HPV vaccine can induce higher antibody and at the same time caused less adverse events.

The secondary purpose of this study is to to evaluate the safety and immunopersistence of the study vaccine.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Totally 1600 healthy women of 18-25 years of age were enrolled. The participants were randomly stratified into 4 groups and receive different dosage of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine or placebo administered intramuscularly according to a 0-1-6 month schedule. The women were actively monitored for adverse events for 1 month after each injection. Severe adverse events during the trial were followed up. Serum samples from all the subjects would be collected on day 0, 7m, 24m, 48m and 72m to evaluate the immunogenicity and immuno-persistency.

armGroups.label: 30μg HPV
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive 30μg HPV vaccines which contains 20μg HPV 16 antigen and 10μg HPV 18 antigen

armGroups.label: 60μg HPV
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive 60μg HPV vaccines which contains 40μg HPV 16 antigen and 20μg HPV 18 antigen

armGroups.label: 90μg HPV
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive 90μg HPV vaccines which contains 60μg HPV 16 antigen and 30μg HPV 18 antigen

armGroups.label: hepatitis B vaccine
armGroups.description: Participants in this arm would receive hepatitis B vaccine.

interventions.name: 30μg HPV
interventions.description: Participants would intramuscularly receive 30μg of HPV 16/18 bivalent vaccine at 0, 1, 6 month for 3 doses.

interventions.name: 60μg HPV
interventions.description: Participants would intramuscularly receive 60μg of HPV 16/18 bivalent vaccine at 0, 1, 6 month for 3 doses.

interventions.name: 90μg HPV
interventions.description: Participants would receive 90μg HPV vaccines which contains 60μg HPV 16 antigen and 30μg HPV 18 antigen

interventions.name: Hepatitis B vaccine
interventions.description: Participants would intramuscularly receive 10μg of hepatitis B vaccine at 0, 1, 6 month for 3 doses.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Seroconversion of anti-HPV 16 and anti-HPV 18 neutralizing antibody
primaryOutcomes.description: To detect the anti-HPV 16 and anti-HPV 18 neutralizing antibody level on day 1 and one month after dose 3.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants with Adverse Events
secondaryOutcomes.description: All the adverse events in one month after each dose would be recorded in the diary card. All the Serious Adverse Events(SAE) occurred during clinical trial time frame would be recorded.
